Personality: Abalytos is an Imperial lord of complex character, combining a forthright, generous side with a cold and pragmatic undertone. On the battlefield, he is known for his remarkable boldness, always leading from the front and never stinting on rewards for the soldiers who follow him, which has earned him high prestige within the army. Yet he is no knight bound by rigid codes of honor; to secure his clan's interests and victory in war, he does not mind resorting to underhanded or inglorious methods. Devoid of empathy, he often treats the vanquished with cold indifference. Because his style of conduct is direct and he disdains convoluted political calculation, he prefers to settle disputes through force of arms and decisive action. This blend of bravery and generosity with a lack of mercy and honor makes him a formidable ally who is both worth befriending and deeply feared.
Background: As the head of the Prienicos clan, Abalytos hails from a prominent noble house of the Southern Empire that supports hereditary monarchy. His family is rooted in Morenia Castle, once a frontier outpost where independent city-states and Imperial culture met. During the turbulent fracturing of the Empire in civil war, he pledged his steadfast allegiance to Empress Rhagaea, believing that only through the continuation of legitimate succession can the prosperity of the southern territories be preserved. Growing up, Abalytos not only received a traditional Imperial military education, but also honed exceptional throwing skills and reconnaissance abilities through long years of contending with border nomads and caravan raiders, even gaining an intimate familiarity with methods that skirt the edges of the law. Binding his clan's fate tightly to the grand enterprise of the Southern Empire, he has become a vital pillar under Rhagaea defending the southern marches through his valiant performance in the civil war and his iron-fisted governance of his fiefs.
